notes.title: Patchnote for Lumione Demo

tags.bug: 1. Fixed the issue that the character can stand on some of the thorns;
2. Fixed the client crash and Fatal Error issue;
3. Fixed the issue that the character can pass through the air wall in certain scenes.

tags.balance_change: 1. The character will recover its flight count when passing the level boundary to reach the next/previous level;
2. Adjusted the length of time that the text appears in the prologue when the character gains new abilities;
3. Optimized the Control Prompts for character flying;
4. Optimized the operation feel of the interaction between the character and the wall;
5. Optimized the collision determination between the character and the thorns.
Modified the level structure of the last level in Chapter 2.
